author: Eniu234
quote: The game is absolutely unplayable. 20 unstable fps with consistent glitches. The game was rescheduled for over a year, for what exactly? Its still a buggy mess. Not to mention you cant even steal cars in a GTA game. Instead you're taking part in a house renovation project with the worst side missions i've ever seen. I have no idea how it received 99 from the critics, by far the most overhyped game of all time.
